other_failure_modes.description: The agent identifies text columns but only extracts basic surface-level string statistics (like length and word counts), completely discarding the actual semantic textual content instead of utilizing TF-IDF, bag-of-words, or embeddings.

summary: The agent implements a functional baseline pipeline but critically fails by framing the binary classification task as a single-group ranking problem using LGBMRanker, which is fundamentally the wrong model type and formulation.
